analysis.reasonEn: The sell decision has been maintained for the past 3 trading days. RSI fell from 43.4 to 40.5, confirming entry into oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from -2.7561 to -3.2293, reinforcing the downtrend. A Lower Low was formed with the 5-day low at $115.84 and the 20-day low at $101.06, continuing the downtrend pattern. The current price of $122.09 is testing the support near SMA200 at $121.11, but the prevailing weak momentum suggests a higher probability of further decline.
